# YearOnGit

> YearOnGit turns a developer's GitHub year into a cinematic Wrapped-style
> recap: contributions, languages, streaks, highlights, and shareable cards.

YearOnGit is a free web product. Users sign in with GitHub (read-only OAuth),
generate a year-in-review experience, and optionally share a public link or
README Markdown card.

## Primary pages

- [Home](/): Generate your GitHub Wrapped — product landing
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Three steps from GitHub sign-in to a shareable card
- [FAQ](/faq): Pricing, permissions, README cards, sharing, and data
- [Privacy](/privacy): Data handling and OAuth scopes
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use
- [Shared Wrapped](/share/{slug}): Public share links for a finished Wrapped

## Private / non-indexable

- /wrapped — authenticated Wrapped player
- /loading — auth loading state
- /admin — operators only
- /api/* — application APIs

## Product facts

- Brand: YearOnGit
- Category: developer tools / GitHub year-in-review
- Auth: GitHub OAuth (read-only)
